proposals.evidence: Turner7576 explicitly lists Shumashti nun today under nūnam now, alongside Pashai nū and Gawri nūn. Buddruss p26 item16 confirms Shumashti nun as a distinct comparison, not a variant of Grangali ac.

proposals.evidence: Turner11625 explicitly marks Pashai Kurangali vel as the donor of Shumashti wyel. Existing donor f_hv6ravplmmn4m has canonical Pas, dialect Kurangali and verified rank1 ancestry11625. Buddruss p31 item97 independently gives Shumashti wyel. Use this immediate donor rather than a direct reflex to vikāla.
